This binding is linked to the activation of Adra2a, a key receptor in the adrenergic system. The multiple paths highlight a consistent interaction between Levonordefrin and the Alpha-2 adrenergic receptor, with Adra2a being a central node in this network. The varying scores reflect the strength of the evidence, with the highest confidence in the connection between Levonordefrin and Adra2c, which is further supported by its participation in the Adrenaline Signalling Through Alpha-2 Adrenergic Receptor pathway. The integration of these pathways underscores a mechanistic link between Levonordefrin and Adra2a, suggesting that the compound may modulate adrenergic signaling through the Alpha-2 receptor, potentially influencing physiological processes related to the adrenergic system.
